>Is there any official posting of results? From what I heard, Case Western
>took not only #1 but #2 in their region this year...

There will be an offical posting. The offical results will be announced
early in December. One reason the results have not been
released yet is that not all of the regional programming contests
have taken place. It might be a good idea for us (readers of this
newsgroup) to wait for the official announcement.
Wouldn't it be embarrassing if the outcome is not
what we thought it was?
